page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Below the head, a dedication title in italic, then a greeting in italic, then one block of running text. Signature at the bottom left and catchword at the bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Reverendo admodum Eruditissimoque Vi-ro D. Joanni Morino, Ordinis Orato-
rii Presbytero.
ET opportunum satis ad vos, & gra-
tum pervenisse illud primum officii
mei specimen, quod vobis pridem mit-
tendum duxeram, mihi Epistolâ tuâ per-
humaniter ad me scriptâ innotuisse, ju-
cundum inprimis fuit, neque hoc pacto
amicitiæ benevolentiæque tuæ titulo at-
que tessera donatum, immo insignitum
serio equidem gaudeo. Quod autem
porro in eadem postulare te memini,
nam mihi respondere volenti jam ad ma-
num Epistola ipsa non erat, ut quod re-
liquum fuerat annotationum istarum
adjiceretur, id quia serum jam putabam,
cum in procinctu esse emittendi à vobis
Libri viderentur, pene consilium scri-
bendi omiseram, nisi eas adhuc quoque expectari admonitus
à quodam nuper essem. En igitur, Vir doctissime, jam
tandem posteriorum quoque Pentateu-

page.notes: Catchword "chi" completes "Pentateuchi" and is kept out of the text. The large initial E is read as "ET". Long s is written as s throughout. Ornaments, ink spots, pencil marks at the top left, and the digitiser's banner at the bottom right are left out.
